name: Codex-X
description: OpenAI Codex 桌面端/CLI 的可视化管理工具，具有Provider/API 切换、会话同步、提示词注入、Skills/MCP 管理、TOML 配置可视化的跨平台工具。
one_liner: A visual control panel for people who use OpenAI's Codex coding assistant, letting them switch API providers, manage prompt templates, and sync sessions without hand-editing config files.
buyer: A developer or small dev team already using Codex CLI/desktop across multiple AI providers who wants to manage settings visually instead of editing TOML files by hand.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer juggling several AI API providers uses it to switch between them quickly without touching config files.
A small dev team standardizes prompt templates and MCP/skill configs across members using the shared visual management layer.
A power user builds and sells a curated pack of prompt templates and Skills/MCP configs compatible with this tool.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a curated pack of prompt templates, Skills, and MCP configs designed to drop into this tool.

steal_this: This is a niche developer utility for a specific tool's power users. Honest take: useful for that audience, but too narrow to build a standalone business around; a template pack is the realistic side-project.
